sourceFamilies.description: Official shelter or disaster facility lists from Chuo City, Tokyo Metropolitan Government, or other government source systems.
sourceFamilies.expectedUse: Primary evidence for official shelter/facility records and supported disaster categories.
risks: license or attribution requirements may be unclear
coordinates or addresses may not align cleanly to PLATEAU buildings
facility categories may not map directly to evacuation building status

sourceFamilies.description: Official evacuation building or vertical evacuation facility records, if available separately from general shelter lists.
sourceFamilies.expectedUse: Strongest evidence for official evacuation building designation.
risks: source may be map-only or PDF-only
building-level designation may be ambiguous for multi-building facilities
source update date may be missing

sourceFamilies.description: Official tsunami, flood, storm surge, or related hazard map products and GIS layers.
sourceFamilies.expectedUse: Hazard context for candidate screening, warnings, and safe-floor interpretation.
risks: map scope may not cover Chuo Ward
PDF maps may not provide reproducible geometry
hazard context can be mistaken for flood simulation if not labeled carefully

sourceFamilies.description: Administrative disaster prevention plans and official policy documents defining evacuation concepts, facility roles, or planning assumptions.
sourceFamilies.expectedUse: Rule interpretation, terminology, and source-family semantics.
risks: policy text may not identify specific buildings
interpretation may require Japanese terminology review
older plans may conflict with newer facility data

sourceFamilies.description: PLATEAU building footprints, geometry, and derived spatial representation available after controlled pipeline processing.
sourceFamilies.expectedUse: Building matching, spatial containment, nearest-building checks, and Unity-ready geometry linkage.
risks: CityGML parsing is not allowed in P5-A1
building IDs and geometry may not align with official facility points
multi-part facilities may map to multiple buildings

sourceFamilies.description: PLATEAU building attributes that may support matching or candidate review after controlled extraction.
sourceFamilies.expectedUse: Secondary support for candidate suitability, building type, height, floors, and matching confidence.
risks: attributes may be missing or inconsistent
height/floor fields may not be available for all buildings
attributes do not prove official evacuation designation

sourceFamilies.description: Academic, policy, or technical report criteria for vertical evacuation building suitability.
sourceFamilies.expectedUse: Candidate qualification rules and warning logic.
risks: criteria may not be specific to Chuo Ward
paper assumptions may not match official disaster scenarios
criteria can be overinterpreted as official designation

sourceFamilies.description: Academic, policy, or technical report criteria for walking distance, evacuation time, accessibility, and vulnerable population constraints.
sourceFamilies.expectedUse: Route accessibility and manual review warning rules.
risks: route estimates may not reflect real emergency behavior
vulnerable population assumptions may require careful interpretation
accessibility criteria do not prove official designation

sourceFamilies.description: OSM-derived pedestrian network data used as auxiliary routing input for prototype route estimates.
sourceFamilies.expectedUse: Prototype route estimation, accessibility warnings, and route confidence metadata.
risks: OSM routes are not official evacuation routes
network completeness and pedestrian tags may be inconsistent
OSM data changes over time and needs reproducibility controls
